steps.content: Within the Apostle Black Ring, the sea of Mania shivers with a subtle, alien disturbance. A foreign force has begun to seep into its depths.
Guided by an unseen hand, the Aurum Secretum's resonance center is transferred into the heart of the Black Ring. Invisible waves of energy coalesce, solidifying into threads of shimmering gold.
The threads multiply, weaving an intricate and relentless web that begins its slow, methodical sweep across the entire space.
A single golden filament grazes ${PlayerName}'s body, drawing a fine line of blood. He doesn't stir. He has retreated too far within to feel anything now.
steps.female_content: A single golden filament grazes ${PlayerName}'s body, drawing a fine line of blood. She doesn't stir. She has retreated too far within to feel anything now.

steps.content: The fine web trembles once, pausing as if making a final confirmation.

With verification granted, the golden web begins to draw closed. It tightens like a fist, the threads pulling closer, denser, deadlier. It will not stop until it has shrunk to the size of a person, and there, at its heart, it will excise its target from existence.
—But at that very moment, something blocks its path.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I had a dream... a long, long dream...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: There was this river, a wide, deep, rushing river...

She tightens her hold on ${PlayerName}. Her own body becomes a shield, intercepting the lethal light of the web. She holds firm, but she knows if the opposing force amplifies its power even a fraction, her frail protection will shatter immediately.
Perhaps later, once her body has mended... then, she is certain she could stop it completely.
There is nothing more she can do now... She's just not as strong as ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How am I supposed to fight this? How strong do I have to be to walk against the current...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tell me, ${PlayerName}... You're always pushing forward, always ahead of me...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...You never lose... You always figure it out... Right?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Wake up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This is a joke, right? Stop messing with me and wake up... Tell me you're fine... Look at me...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Was it me? Is this because I was just sitting here, pathetically waiting for you to save me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Then forget saving me... Just save yourself! Wake up and get out of here... You hear me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn Black Ring, let me talk to him...
steps.female_content: Damn Black Ring, let me talk to her...

steps.content: And so, Mania grants her wish.
Spike after spike, the pitch-black shackles pierce ${PlayerName}'s body, merging with the Black Ring and Hella's own form. Through this newly forged connection floods a profound and intense emotion.

Failed　　　　　 <size=38>I failed</size>　　　　<size=50> Why? Where did I go wrong?</size>　　　<size=52><color=#fb9259> I'm sorry</color></size> <size=50>I'm sorry</size>
　　　　　　　　 Think again <size=38>Try one more time</size> <color=#fb9259><size=52>Am I not enough? </color></size>Who else? Who can do it?

　　　　　　<size=38>She's waiting</size> Find another way 　　Can't let go, must not fail
<size=42> One more time</size>, one more time, <size=52> try again </size>　　　　　　<color=#fb9259> Just one more step</color></size>

<size=45>Be <color=#fb9259>stronger </color></size> 　　　　　 Try harder </size>
<color=#fb9259><size=52>Can't you do it?</color></size>
...Am I really this weak?
Tears shimmer in her eyes as light finally returns to the young girl's once-lifeless gaze.
In this moment, she understands everything. These are the emotions Hella knows most intimately, the very feelings that reside within her own heart. But...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Dummy... don't talk about yourself like that... I've been watching you all along...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...You're obviously the strongest person ever...
A ripple disturbs the Mania space. Sensing the shift within the girl, the departed souls grow restless.
They coalesce from the chaos, swarming from all directions. They wail as they rush toward Hella, pulling at her, pleading with her, desperate to pry the two apart.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I know... I want to go with you all too...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But look at him...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I know I'm not strong... but even so, I still have things I don't want to lose...
She clutches ${PlayerName}'s hand, her grip tightening until warmth seeps back into her long-frozen limbs, until she can feel the steady rhythm of a precious heartbeat once more.
Just one more time. Don't let go. Even knowing she's out of her depth, she has to try.
Let the filth that corrupts you, corrupt me instead. Let the thorns that pierce you, pierce me in your stead. I will bear your suffering. I will carry your burden.
This stupid power of mine... it's useless for anything but patching myself up. But hey, at least it makes me a little stronger... At least I can hold on just a little longer...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I still can't do it... not on my own... But you're here now... I'll just borrow your strength...

The shackles piercing your body shudder and respond to her call. They rip free, only to plunge deep into Hella's own flesh. They writhe and burrow into her—a parasitic frenzy spreading, merging, and corrupting her very essence. They grow relentlessly, until—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get out of my way...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm... taking him back!
Go now...
You're home...

Bent by tremendous magnetic forces, even the Black Ring twists in response. The invisible threads tear asunder while shards of weathered metal draw together and merge. The contamination within is suppressed, shaped, and bound to the metal, reborn into the perfect instrument of war its master desires.

Thus, the general who single-handedly charged into the heart of the Black Ring seizes her glory. With a skyward sweep of her blade, she effortlessly cleaves a rift within the Apostle's body before spurring her warhorse onward, leaping toward the next battle!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Now, all units—stand ready!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Crush them all!

steps.speaker: DisCorps Troops
steps.content: CHARGE!!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Enough with the act. I know you're awake. On your feet. We have work to do.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Any longer, and I'll be the one claiming the trophy for taking down that Black Ring.
The massive Apostle disintegrates—born from instability, now unmade by it.

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: Come...

You struggle to your feet. Before you are the souls that once barred your path, yet now they release their hold without a fight. Has their wish changed? Or did you, in that fractured resistance, finally come to understand their pain, allowing them to achieve what they desired?

Their voices rise in a chorus, merging with the disintegrating Black Ring to birth a new, twisted form. These whispers—fleeting, ephemeral—were forgotten in death and ignored even as part of the Black Ring. Only in this final collapse do they at last leave a tangible mark upon the world.

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: Our wish... is coming true...

The newborn creature calls to you, its voice a soft yet desperate plea, as if... those souls, too, are hoping. They hope that you might understand them, as Hella understands you; that you might share their pain, as Hella shares yours.

This is their final yearning: though their fate is sealed, if others can see their hatred and bear the weight of their pain, that shared burden may become an antidote to their suffering, much like... the shackles.
